The last real campaign commit is still the BDX red team of 2026-09-15, 39 days back, and CLAUDE.md still carries no lift line for either pause. The click queue and the edits block were both empty when read from the live artifact (version 1792243724-438a); nothing to drain. One new indicator tripped: neocloud-export-compliance S1, CoreWeave (CRWV) at 61.82 on 2026-10-21 against a 70 level, tripped 2026-10-23, 14 trips on file (was 13). The Korean shipyards on the methanol chain fell hard after last week's trip: Hanwha Ocean 57,200 KRW on 2026-10-22 (from 67,000 on 10-14, a 52-week low) and HD Korea Shipbuilding 252,000 (from 280,500, also a 52-week low), while the IMO vote of 2026-10-01 is still unswept so the machine does not know which scenario it is weighting. ACM, the only INVESTABLE name, printed 58.99 on 2026-10-20 (52-week low now 58.02, was 58.28), 3.3% under its 61.00 entry floor, and the fresh file was fetched 2026-10-22. CALM printed a new low (61.72 on 2026-10-20, was 62.71). Against that, several WATCH names rallied to or near their 52-week highs, further above their would-buy zones than at the dive: WST 383.91, BDX 193.80, HALO 125.63. Stale or silent, named: radar (a seventh week without intake; EVT-20260901-01, the IMO MEPC vote, still WATCHING nine weeks after the card was written); campaign (ATI-INC never dived, two chains still carrying the wrong stage); the NVDA, HUBB, NVT, MYRG, ONT, STE, VRT, VIRT and VPK.AS price files end on 2026-10-16 or earlier, 8 to 10 days old at this digest; the Federal Reserve press-release feed is the one failed source on the latest feed run; eight of nine agents have no ledger evidence in 21 days because the pauses removed their work. Date pressure: SIG-20260901-02 (rare earth) is 33 days past its review_by and the suspension it is about expires 2026-11-10, 17 days out; SIG-20260828-02 (Tibet mega-dam) is 9 days past its review_by of 2026-10-15. GD and WST dives reach review_by on 2026-10-30, 6 days out. Shadow book: 81 rows, none graded, none due (earliest review_at 2026-11-26). Deferred backlog is 125 OPEN, up from 120, 45 in the safe-push-detached-worktree bucket.

ranked.title: ACM, the only INVESTABLE call, is now 3.3% under its entry floor and made a new 52-week low
ranked.case: ACM's dive (data/stocks/ACM__data-center-moratoria.json) sets the entry zone at $61.00 to $71.00 with no_entry_above $75.00 and review_by 2026-12-04; the $61.00 floor is where the dive's own reverse-DCF bisection (base FCF $684.9M, 9% discount, 2.5% terminal growth) asks for zero real FCF growth, and it sat on the 2026-08-12 low of $61.04. data/market/ACM.json (fetched 2026-10-22) now ends on a $58.99 close on 2026-10-20 with the 52-week low at $58.02, down from $58.28 a week ago, so the stock has broken its own floor twice in two weeks and is $2.01 under it, against $66.58 on the day the dive was written. Two S5 indicators (data-center-moratoria and minor-nsr-permits) already stand tripped on the 2026-09-24 close of $58.52. The dive's own question is now sharper again: either the zone is cheaper than the dive priced it, or the consultancy de-rating is the first evidence the thesis is wrong. Nothing in the dive changes at this price; what the weekend decides is whether to refresh the dive before 2026-12-04 or wait for the review date. The price is four days old at this digest.

ranked.title: The methanol-chain shipyards fell another 10 to 15% in a week while the IMO vote that decides the scenario is still unswept
ranked.case: SIG-20260901-04 rests on the divergence between the IMO Net-Zero Framework postponement and Singapore's methanol-bunkering licences running regardless. The reconvened MEPC session, EVT-20260901-01 dated 2026-10-01, is still WATCHING in data/calendar/events.json because radar, the stage that sweeps the calendar, is paused, so the outcome is not on disk. The chain's price indicators keep moving the same direction they moved last week: S2 (Hanwha Ocean 042660.KS, trip at or below 70,000 KRW, tripped 2026-10-14 at 67,000) is now 57,200 on 2026-10-22, a 14.6% further drop to a new 52-week low (the 52-week high is 149,900); S5 (HD Korea Shipbuilding 009540.KS, tripped 2026-10-02 at 323,500) is now 252,000, 10.2% below the 280,500 of a week ago and also a new 52-week low. The terminal side keeps the other half of the story: Royal Vopak (VPK.AS) closed 53.35 on 2026-10-16, its 52-week high, above the S3 trip level of 49.00. Shipyards weakening and terminals strengthening is exactly the split the card describes, and it is now large. What the weekend can settle is which scenario this resolves to, and only a radar sweep of the 2026-10-01 vote can say.

ranked.title: New this week: CoreWeave broke through the S1 level, and the chain it sits on has no named buyable link yet
ranked.case: SIG-20260901-01 argues the compliance-verification layer behind AI-chip export control is unpriced and that named public exposure is thin: Nvidia is the only large listed name, the operative Southeast Asian actors are private, and the card records those weaknesses itself. The chain's S1 indicator (the remote-access rule goes final; CoreWeave, the richer-discounted of the two neocloud tickers on this link, breaks below its recent range, level 70) tripped on 2026-10-23: data/market/CRWV.json shows a 61.82 close on 2026-10-21 against a 52-week low of 60.82 and a high of 139.93, so CRWV is 55.8% under its high and 11.7% under the trip level. The other trip on this chain, S3 (NVDA above 235.74, tripped 2026-10-08 at 239.24) is a past event: NVDA's last file print is 214.13 on 2026-10-16, 9.2% under that level. The honest read is that the chain's two indicators have now pointed in opposite directions inside three weeks, one for the incumbent and one for the neocloud that the compliance rule is meant to squeeze, and no dive exists on this chain to say whether either is a buying opportunity or the premise failing.

ranked.title: The rare-earth suspension expires in 17 days and the card is 33 days past its own review date
ranked.case: SIG-20260901-02 is about China's rare-earth technology-export suspension, which the card dates to expire 2026-11-10, 17 days from this digest; its review_by of 2026-09-21 passed 33 days ago, and its unmappedness was already the lowest-conviction call on the board (58, held there because Tally's impact appraisal IMP-20260830-16 scored it LEAKY with public_reach 40 and found one confirmed listed name, Neo Performance Materials). The chain's S1 indicator, 300748.SZ, stays inside a band it left earlier (trip level below 32, seen 24.78 at trip); the file now ends on 24.14 on 2026-10-20 against a 52-week low of 22.12 and a high of 46.90, so it has not recovered. The date is the reason this is on the list: an expiry inside three weeks is the one event in the funnel with a known resolution date and no stage running against it. Ron's decision is whether to refresh the card before 2026-11-10 or let the date pass unanalyzed.

ranked.title: Tibet mega-dam passed its review date 9 days ago, with two FINAL WATCH dives hanging off it
ranked.case: SIG-20260828-02 (unmappedness 88) passed its review_by of 2026-10-15 nine days ago. Two FINAL WATCH dives sit on the chain, both with review_by 2026-11-30 and neither carrying a would-buy zone: ANDR.VI (79.70 on 2026-10-19, 52-week range 59.50 to 86.10, so 7.4% under its high, the strongest of the pair) and 688425.SS (3.98 on 2026-10-20 against a 52-week low of 3.91, 1.8% above it; the dive was written at 4.08). The chain's heat and scenarios date from 2026-08-29 and 2026-09-02, the oldest on the board. The card's own caveat is that most of the money goes to Chinese state enterprises, which is what made the Tibet dives WATCH in the first place. Nothing on this chain moved analytically this week; it is on the list because its review date has passed and two dives depend on it.
